ValidationRule.description: Case can be reopen only with the status "Reopen". Case cannot be changed to "New" value.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($User.ER_BypassVR__c), OR( AND( ISCHANGED(Status), IsClosed, NOT(ISPICKVAL( Status ,"Reopen")) ), AND( ISCHANGED(Status), ISPICKVAL( Status ,"New") ), AND( ISNEW(), ISPICKVAL( Status ,"Reopen") ) ) )
